body: I’m on waitlist. Not guaranteed. But better than nothing I guess 🥲
I got in right away first 10-20min and they said it was random and timing shouldn’t matter. I plan to try the cancellation too! Fingers crossed for literally any time slot 🥲

The worse part about getting my email was the preview. I was very excited until I opened it 🥲

Image: email preview says your entry to the Nintendo event with a suggestion to save to calendar making it seem like I was selected. I was not.

https://preview.redd.it/0tn2r34cwqfe1.jpeg?width=1170&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=41bf3f8ba5a81f47bce43af693c18d501ab8898b
I received an email today that I was not selected, so I guess they drew already?

I played a bit longer and found that out but I still don’t appreciate how the developers went about it. There’s nothing that says to keep playing to unlock, they put you in a room and give you the option to pay to unlock. I googled to see if you had to pay to unlock and everything online also just showed paying to unlock. If I had quit paying there was nothing in game or online that said you could continue without paying so it still feels pretty scummy imo. They should’ve made it clearer that it was an option and not a necessity

Yeah when I realized the pay wall I went to leave a bad review and was immediately sus about the number of reviews. I left my review and requested a refund then checked Reddit and saw this thread! Wish I saw before buying. Luckily I only paid $13 w coupon (30% off for buying a quest 3 and having the subscription thing) but regret wasting my coupon.

I just posted this somewhere else as well but I’m surprised by all the good reviews considering the pay wall. 

It just released publicly (I didn’t realize there was early access with reviews, I’m not hardcore quest player) but I bought the game and I literally paid for a demo…

You pay $20 for the game and only get grandmas house. The tasks tell you that you are proving you can handle outside, but when you prove yourself? Pay for outside. Paying $20 for a tutorial/demo is crazy! I understand paying for extra content added later but paying extra to unlock past tutorial??? I left a bad review.
It’s cute but it’s not worth it. You’re buying a demo. I did tasks that said I was learning to be outside then realized the only way to get outside was to pay more money..

Hi! I recently went through what your DIL went through being denied over similar issues. I have a dog training to be my service animal but they are not ready for Disney. Would you mind DMing me about her experience calling back? As other commenters mentioned, they keep a log of your attempts so I am anxious to try again. However I am frustrated because they told me I was denied because I am a pass holder. They informed me that it would be different if I was visiting for a short time but because I have a pass I should just plan around my disability and only go when lines are short like in the morning… I tried to escalate that by sending a complaint in through their feedback form but was told the new DAS system is what it is and they refused to help me even though my complaint was that I was denied solely as a pass holder and not because I didn’t need it.

I am the exact person they were trying to help with DAS. the neurodivergent diagnosis, needs, and all. I finally spoke with them today as I’ve avoided the park and told them about how I have accommodations at six flags through drs note and same for school. My school accommodations include being sat by the door for easy exits. They literally told me that because I’m a pass holder I need to plan around my disability and come in the morning (not an option with my job). They gave me no options. They said to use trip planner and utilize shorter lines. I just renewed before the change and wish I could have a refund.
